ingredients: 400 g all-purpose flour (or dumpling flour; ~2.5 cups + a bit more)
240 g room-temperature water (a bit less than 1 cup)
500 g chicken thighs (boneless; remove large tendons)
3 g ginger (paste / pureed / finely chopped; 1/2 tsp)

steps: Prepare the dough Mix flour + salt. Add water and mix with a scraper until a shaggy dough forms. Rest 20 minutes. Knead until smooth. Cover and rest 1 hour.

Make the filling Prep cilantro: remove some leaves (to reduce bitterness), wash well (including roots), drain thoroughly, chop, and mix with a little sesame oil. Prep chicken: chop chicken thighs and season with soy sauce, ginger, egg white, white pepper, five-spice, and salt. Aromatic oil: add chopped green onion to the chicken. Heat vegetable oil until smoking, pour it over the green onions, then stir the mixture in one direction until tacky. Fold in the cilantro at the end.

Wrap + pan-fry (potsticker style) Roll out wrappers and wrap dumplings into your desired shape. Put a little oil in a cast iron pot/pan and arrange dumplings before the pot is fully heated. Add 1/4 cup water and cover with a lid. Steam 4–5 minutes, until the water evaporates. Once the water is gone, fry 1 additional minute until bottoms are crispy and golden.
